data.title: Add reproducible frozen MP2 verifier and seven-page report
data.body:
A small CPU verifier selects one of four supplied candidates using train-fitted relation features and multi-positive listwise loss. Validation: 724/798 (90.7268%). After the pre-test source/asset freeze, official full test: 348/467 (74.51820128479658%). No test-driven model changes.

Validation baselines and ablations, the unselected nonconverged configuration, train-only OOF calibration, negative relation-BCE result, confidence diagnostics and limitations are retained. The seven-page report is reports/report.pdf.

Validation: eight numerical/boundary tests; isolated synthetic/validation contract and data-access checks; unchanged official hashes. Assets: 51,923 bytes. Initial local complete CPU evaluation: 0.705959 seconds, one OpenBLAS thread on i9-12900H; reference-machine eligibility is not claimed.

Independent AI internal review passed (docs/CODE_REVIEW.md). Anonymous public clone of commit 92c7240c5a4710054de1363d23e2f11f81d33b72 in a new Python3.12/NumPy-only environment, independently downloaded official data, reproduced the identical official score and all 467 selected indices without training. Complete reproduction wall time: 1.1398808 seconds. Code/report/config/weights are anonymously downloadable and hash-verified; evidence is in docs/REPRODUCTION.md and results/reproduction/. Later changes add records and official-form tooling, preserving frozen source commit 8602992842d444524ab4148991da2f1dc88f316f and both checkpoint files.

AI internal review is not human approval or teacher certification. Course submission and later instructor-opened peer review are separate workflows.
